rubrics.justification: Overall description is consistent with an expanded blastocyst with visible ICM and thinned zona, and it reasonably matches the provided 3AA grade. Minor overstatement exists regarding uniformly strong TE visualization and some fine details not clearly discernible from this single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, AMH, oocyte yield, prior failed cycles, endometrial thickness, semen parameters, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a plausible probability estimate tied to embryo quality and prior failures. Minor issues include somewhat strong inferences from AMH/oocyte yield and broad assumptions about recurrent implantation failure after only two failed cycles.

Core recommendations such as proceeding with SET are guideline-concordant, but several suggested add-ons/workups (ERA, NK testing, broad thrombophilia/MTHFR testing, routine estradiol or hCG luteal support, growth hormone) are not strongly supported for routine use by major guidelines.

Provides clear next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, including SET and further evaluation if unsuccessful. Slightly reduced by inclusion of some low-evidence investigations and adjuncts without stronger prioritization.
